title: Go Green, IBA Approved & ISO Certified | Vidhi Transport
description: Review Vidhi Transport's Go Green initiative, IBA approval and ISO certification, and request current supporting documents for verification.

hero.title: Three credentials presented with the right context.
intro: Vidhi Transport highlights its Go Green initiative, IBA approval and ISO certification. Request the current supporting documents when completing procurement or vendor checks.
list: Review the current document and validity period.
Match the legal entity name before relying on a credential.
Publish the exact ISO standard only after checking the certificate.

sections.title: Clear signals, not unexplained badges
intro: The three items serve different purposes. Go Green is an operating initiative; IBA approval and ISO certification rely on their current supporting documents.

cards.title: Go Green
body: A practical commitment to more considered logistics through route planning, load consolidation and the reduction of avoidable movement where operationally possible.

cards.title: IBA Approved
body: An important procurement and finance-related trust signal. Ask for the current IBA approval document and confirm its applicability for your organisation or consignment.

cards.title: ISO Certified
body: The public label remains intentionally general until the precise ISO standard, certificate number, issuing body, scope and validity are verified against the current certificate.

sections.title: Need documents for your approval process?
intro: Tell us which current supporting document your procurement or compliance team requires.
